jobs.name: 01_violin
jobs.title: 01 · 小提琴
jobs.prompt:
Create a polished game weapon concept design board for Project S, a first-person musical fantasy action roguelite. Use the attached image ONLY as the established art-direction reference: retro hand-drawn anime cel shading, clean dark contour lines, 2-3 restrained value bands, ivory, burnished antique gold, midnight navy, warm reddish wood, burgundy fabric, small turquoise resonance glows. Elegant playful concert-instrument craft, readable chunky shapes, restrained baroque flourishes, practical joints and straps. NOT science fiction, no modern firearm receiver, picatinny rail, ammunition bullets, digital screen, photorealism, gritty rust or excessive glowing clutter. This is a new musical instrument weapon, NOT a gun with an instrument ornament glued onto it.
Landscape 3:2 concept sheet. One unique weapon design only. On the left, a large isolated complete three-quarter hero design occupying 70 percent of the sheet, on a warm ivory background with a soft grounding shadow; show all components and generous clear margins. In the lower right, one smaller framed first-person use vignette showing THE SAME exact instrument and human hands in burgundy fingerless gloves, instrument held low in the frame and emitting a small attack toward the open central aim area in a softly suggested theater. No full character, no HUD, no crosshair, no photorealism. A short heading at top, one concise English role subtitle, and tiny numbered arrows for tuning/activation/holding points. Keep the weapon and its playing mechanism immediately identifiable and physically coherent. The main illustration must dominate. Match the established reference linework and materials, not its entire screenshot layout.
Board heading: 01  VIOLIN | BALANCED
Balanced rifle equivalent: 30-note capacity, moderate rhythmic firing. A handsome compact four-string violin with clear waist, two f-holes, scroll and polished chestnut body; sculpted antique brass protective edge, midnight-blue chin-rest, a removable slim ivory perforated score cartridge under the body. Keep the violin primarily an acoustic instrument. Separate elegant bow is part of this single weapon set. Playing across the strings releases evenly spaced small golden musical bolts toward the forward aim. In the first-person vignette left hand supports the neck, right hand draws the bow, body sits low and the neck leads diagonally toward the center. Distinguishing silhouette: double-waisted wooden body and fine long bow. Show tuning pegs and cartridge seam for reload/retune animation. No rifle stock or trigger.

Board heading: 02  FLUTE | RAPID
SMG equivalent: very fast fire, 50-note capacity, lightweight agile weapon. A short concert flute with ivory-and-silver cylindrical body, offset articulated antique-brass keywork and turquoise inset pads, dark navy finger rests, tiny removable tuning cylinder at the heel. Recognizable as a FLUTE, not a clarinet, trumpet, pipe gun or magical wand. Two hands can support the keywork; visually show pressed keys releasing a lively train of small cyan note projectiles from the far end through a delicate resonance ring. The compact flute sits diagonally across the lower first-person frame, leaving the center readable. Its design communicates short rhythmic bursts and quick tuning, with no ammo magazine and no firearm mechanism. Distinguishing silhouette: slender straight tube with rhythmic circular keys.

Board heading: 03  FRAME DRUM | BURST
Shotgun equivalent: slow heavy rhythmic hits, 10-beat capacity; each strike triggers TWO musical payloads. A thick single round handheld frame drum with cream drum skin, burgundy wooden hoop, restrained gold studs, navy tension bands, two clearly concentric resonance patterns integrated into the drum face. A rear adjustable hand grip and forearm strap; a small brass tuning ratchet on the rim. Left hand carries the drum low like a small buckler, right bare palm with fingerless glove strikes it, creating TWO overlapping fan-shaped golden sound bursts with scattered short note shards. Do not draw a pair of drums or a gun muzzle. Main artwork three-quarter front shows the rim, membrane and rear handle hint. Distinguishing silhouette: compact circular drum with thick resonant rim. Not a giant shield, no violent sparks.

Board heading: 04  CELLO | PRECISION
Precision marksman equivalent: 9 charged notes, slow precise zero-spread piercing shots. A portable travel cello, clearly larger and deeper than a violin: rich dark mahogany resonator, broad rounded lower bout, elongated ebony fingerboard, four heavy strings, curled scroll, tucked/folding endpin and leather shoulder harness. A small elegant brass alignment/tuning ring integrated near the neck provides a musical sighting reference, NOT a telescopic riflescope. Include its slim bow as part of one instrument set. A deliberate strong bowed note creates one narrow straight pale-blue piercing sound ray. In first-person use the cello body is braced low against the chest using its harness, left hand fingers the neck, right draws the bow, upper center remains open. Distinguishing silhouette: long asymmetric deep cello body and extended neck; NO bipod, gun barrel, military stock or futuristic lens.

Board heading: 05  HARP | RESONANCE
Beam emitter equivalent: an 80-note reservoir and extremely rapid luminous attacks. A compact arm-held seven-string lyre-harp with a strong open triangular/curved harp frame, antique gold column, midnight-blue enamel inlay, cream resonator, seven taut readable strings, small violet tuning crystals inset flush into the upper bridge. No floating disconnected parts. Left forearm supports its padded lower cradle; right hand plucks or sweeps strings. The first-person inset shows a narrow luminous sustained-looking stream assembled from many rapid golden note pulses, subtle violet core and turquoise harmonics. It still looks like a playable harp with distinct strings and soundboard, not a bow, crossbow or laser gun. Retuning is represented by a rotating brass tuning comb along the bridge. Distinguishing silhouette: open gold triangular harp and luminous strings.

Board heading: 06  FRENCH HORN | CHAIN
